status.description: published — included on the provisional ladder; public voting still requires Stage 3. held_parity — legacy status retained for old imports and not a valid reason to hide a newly qualified record. held_review — evidence, context, duplication, or a Committee question is open; see needs and policy_note. withdrawn — retained in the audit record but removed from the public board.

party_at_time.description: FK to parties.json. The party held ON THE DATE OF THE STATEMENT, not today. Defections make this load-bearing; the parity meter counts this field.

neutral_title.description: States what was CLAIMED. Never a verdict about the person. 'On radar and cloud cover', never 'MP thinks clouds block radar'. Enforced in review, not just policy (docs/03-content-pipeline.md §3.3).

quote.description: ORIGINAL-LANGUAGE VERBATIM ONLY. Null if the exact wording has not been established from a source. Never put an English rendering of a non-English remark here, never paraphrase, never reconstruct it from reported speech, and never tidy the grammar. A null quote is a research task; an invented quote is the end of the project.

quote_note.description: Required whenever `quote` is null. For sourced quotes, record transcription or normalization decisions and remaining provenance work here.

quote_translation.description: Faithful English translation of a non-English verbatim quote. Required whenever a non-English `quote` is present.

claim.description: Neutral one-line summary of what was asserted. This is what search and the duel card render when `quote` is null.

context.description: What surrounds the statement. Stage 3 requires the surrounding 60s be watched; this field records what that showed.

counterpoint.description: The factual position, where the statement makes a checkable claim. Kept separate from the sarcasm layer.

policy_note.description: Required for any entry that engages a Rule in docs/04-legal-and-safety.md §4.8 without being rejected by it. Must record the ruling and the reasoning, not just the flag.

axes.description: Seed scores only. They establish the frozen editorial prior for the public rating; equal-strength public rulings progressively outweigh it. Aamne-Saamne exhibition picks never affect this score. See docs/09-seed-corpus.md for the rubric each number is scored against.

stage.description: text_sourced — attributed to a named person by at least one reputable outlet; NOT publishable. av_verified — Tier A/B clip located with a bounded timestamped excerpt and surrounding context watched. committee_passed — the full Stage 3 checklist signed off. Nothing publishes below committee_passed.

needs.description: The specific outstanding work. This is the research queue; treat it as the to-do list, not as documentation.

video.description: Canonical bounded evidence excerpt. YouTube remains externally embedded; rights-cleared Cloudinary uploads are authenticated assets with a verified, version-pinned MP4 derivative. Application validation enforces cross-field duration bounds.
